name: Hakuba Dental
description: A clean, calm theme for family dental clinics: white pages and pale mist-blue cells, Sora headings and Inter text, and a home page laid out as a bento grid of rounded cells, two of them tooth-shaped; a two-tier header with today's opening hours, the phone number, an emergency note and a Book a visit pill in a pale-blue strip; a footer built around the week's opening-hours table; with treatments, an example fee table, the first visit step by step, the clinic and team, a journal, a newsletter and contact with a booking form, in white, mist blue, clinic blue and navy, plus an after-hours dark variation.

fonts.role: headings, numerals, the wordmark and the step numbers
body text, labels, navigation, tables, forms and buttons
